name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User explicitly reported Test17 as normal. Test18 starts the next planned slice: playback history and video favorites, without changing 115 network/search/offline/file-operation protocols.

features: add a compact 最近 entry to File Management
record up to 50 recently played videos when playback is initiated from File Management
allow long-pressing a video in File Management to add/remove it from local video favorites
add a dedicated 最近播放 page with 最近 and 收藏 tabs
recent/favorite records keep fileId, pickCode, display name, size and source-folder breadcrumb so playback and return-to-folder stay one tap away
history-center playback refreshes the recent timestamp and reuses the existing 115Api player.resolve contract
allow open-source-folder, remove-one-item and clear-current-list actions
all history/favorite data is local UI state; no extra 115 request is made when recording or browsing lists
limitations: Phase1 records playback launched from File Management and from the new history center itself

legacy Search and OfflineResult playback paths are intentionally not patched in this version because their request/result chains are established stable baselines; broader cross-entry history capture can be added later after this slice is device-validated
validationTarget: File Management shows a compact 最近 entry
playing a video from File Management creates/updates a recent-play record
最近播放 page can replay the stored video
long-press video 收藏/取消收藏视频 works and 收藏 tab reflects it
打开所在目录 returns to the real source directory with breadcrumb preserved
clearing recent/favorites only clears local UI records and never deletes 115 files
Test17 folder favorites/recent directories, sort/filter, file operations, search, account center, offline center, recycle bin and external magnet flow do not regress
